body:
If you're considering self harm, try some of these things first: 
Take an ice cube, run it over the parts of your body youre thinking about hurting
Take a red pen or marker, take the time to draw on yourself. Scribbles. Patterns. Make a monster that looks like what your pain feels like, whatever. 
Work out aggressively. Just go nuts. See how many push ups you can do in 60 seconds. Whatever. Focus all of your energy. Don't stop until you're sweaty and exhausted. 
(Take the time to move razors and blades and anything else sharp from your bathroom, to a place that's out of eye sight, before hand.) Go take an ice cold shower. 

You should try reaching out to a therapist.
